Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Delhi Project Attendant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the IIT Delhi recruitment is Project Attendant. This is a contractual position offered by the institute.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Attendant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Attendant post in the IIT Delhi recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly without prior online application.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi Project Attendant position?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is not explicitly mentioned as an application deadline, but the Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 17 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Attendant role?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is a Graduate degree with knowledge of project-related operations.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Project Attendant post?
faq.answer: The salary offered ranges from Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 33,000 per month, consolidated.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for IIT Delhi Project Attendant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Attendant position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the Walk-in Interview be held?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at Indian Institute of Technology Delhi, New Delhi - 110016.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates if required, category certificate if applicable), and a duly filled application form if required.
